notes: The 2010–2019 median incidences and the 59% neuroinvasive average are cited from earlier reports and serve as fixed referents for the 2020 estimates computed here; the framework could also be read as a pair of periods. The age groups behind the incidence gradient are not tabulated, so n_groups is null. The estimate of 16,770–39,130 nonneuroinvasive cases applies a cited ratio and is arithmetic.
